run_cfd_rollout_animation: run the python module to animate a CFD trajectory rollout from a pickle file using --rollout_path
plot_cfd_velocity_mesh: plot a triangular mesh visualization of predicted CFD velocity data from rollout pickle data
compute_velocity_bounds: compute the min and max velocity bounds across all trajectories in the rollout data
animate_trajectory_steps: animate CFD trajectory steps using matplotlib FuncAnimation with tripcolor and triplot rendering
load_rollout_pickle: load a CFD rollout pickle file containing ground truth velocity, predicted velocity, mesh positions, and faces
